lockups.title: Clash Royale
lockups.subtitle: PvP Battle in Card Tower Duel
lockups.developerTagline: PvP Battle in Card Tower Duel
lockups.editorialDescription: Colourful chaos awaits in our 2016 iPhone Game of the Year. Supercell’s awesome card battler delivers excellent deck-building mechanics and fast-paced fights in a package that’s easy to understand and undeniably fun. Upgrading, unlocking and experimenting with cards gives the game endless replayability, and deciding just where to drop your heroes makes each battle distinct. But no matter how good your deck is, there’s no substitute for skill and quick thinking.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Collect powerful cards and crush your competition.

lockups.title: Fallout Shelter
lockups.subtitle: Build Your Underground Vault
lockups.editorialDescription: Ever wondered what life’s really like in the Fallout games’ underground vaults? Experience all the challenges of running a post-apocalyptic community—from building gardens and power plants to playing matchmaker for your citizens. Eavesdropping on their goofy conversations never gets old, and an adorable art style à la Fallout’s Pip-Boy cartoons will make series fans swoon. It’s not all lighthearted hijinks, though: Whether at home or exploring the Wasteland, your people will face raiders and other dangers.

lockups.title: Genshin Impact 6th Anniversary
lockups.subtitle: Explore a World of Adventure
lockups.editorialDescription: Elemental magic rules the land of Teyvat in the remarkable Genshin Impact—and as a powerful Traveler, you put this power to good use. Vibrant visual effects transform elemental blasts of fire, ice, and lightning into jaw-dropping spectacles. But it’s not just a looker: Genshin Impact’s beautiful open world is filled with thrilling quests and fascinating secrets. Climb mountains, cook meals, and soar through the skies as you search for your lost sibling—or simply get lost in Teyvat and see what happens.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Explore a new land, and meet amazing new characters.

lockups.title: Pokémon GO
lockups.subtitle: Epic AR adventure & online RPG
lockups.editorialDescription: A phenomenon from the start, Pokémon GO hasn’t stopped evolving. Since launch, the best-in-class location-based AR game has expanded with countless improvements. Hatch eggs while the game runs in the background. Battle other trainers with your favorite creatures. Join memorable community day events. With a steady stream of awesome updates and hundreds of iconic creatures to catch, Niantic’s groundbreaking hit just keeps getting better.

lockups.title: YouTube
lockups.subtitle: Videos, Music and Live Streams
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Watch videos without ads with Premium. Try it free for one month.

lockups.title: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
lockups.subtitle: Watch, discover and stream!
lockups.editorialDescription: If you ever see a group of teenagers (or twenty- or thirtysomethings) filming themselves doing literally anything, know this: They’re probably making a video to share on TikTok. Its infinite scroll of new videos combines perfectly edited lip-synching, hilarious sketches, and mesmerizing dance moves with delightful special effects and filters. It’s hard not to fall in love with everyone’s fluffy pets, awkward parents, impressive glow-ups, fails of every kind, and songs and pop-culture references that spark a million memes.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Make awesome short music videos that you can share with the world.

lockups.title: Tinder Dating App: Date & Chat
lockups.subtitle: Meet New People & Date Singles
lockups.editorialDescription: More than just a dating app, Tinder has been updated to become one of the most engaging, fun, and social apps around. Of course, finding matches is still a huge highlight—but with smart group chats, an awesome Apple TV app, and Super Likes to go around, we’re swiping right on this one.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Get faster matches with Tinder Platinum’s extra features.

lockups.title: Snapchat
lockups.subtitle: Share the moment!
lockups.editorialDescription: From its humble origin as a fun way to send self-erasing photo messages, Snapchat has grown into one of our favorite social media apps. And not just for the hilarious face filters and cool geographical photo tags. It’s become one of the best ways to share memories, maintain friendships, and stay up to date on news and views from our go-to websites.

lockups.title: Hinge Dating App: Match & Date
lockups.subtitle: Meet new people & chat online
lockups.editorialDescription: Daunted by having to fill out a dating app profile? Hinge helps you showcase your best self with conversation prompts (think “Two truths and a lie” or “Let’s debate this topic”) that create fun and flirty ways to engage.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Stop swiping and start a great conversation.

lockups.title: Paramount+
lockups.subtitle: Originals, Movies and Sports
lockups.editorialDescription: Fans of critically acclaimed CBS series like The Good Fight, NCIS, The Stand, and The Late Show With Stephen Colbert will love Paramount+. Sports fans can stream the NCAA tournament, the UEFA Champions League, the NFL on CBS, and the Masters. Newshounds can tune in to 60 Minutes and CBS Evening News. Star Trek series past, present, and future are establishing their home base here too. And there’s loads to watch with kids, including Dora the Explorer, Paw Patrol, Blue’s Clues, and the best of Nickelodeon’s streaming catalog.

lockups.title: Bumble Dating App: Meet & Date
lockups.subtitle: Find new people & chat singles
lockups.editorialDescription: Bumble helps make dating better for everyone by putting shared intentions and interests at the forefront. Skip the small talk and get right to the good stuff with Bumble’s fun features designed to make dating more delightful.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Find love, friendship, or professional connections.

lockups.title: Duolingo: Learn Languages
lockups.subtitle: Spanish, French, Chess & Math
lockups.editorialDescription: With its friendly approach and awesome updates, Duolingo’s long been one of our favorite apps for learning another language. Its secret: making the process genuinely fun. Engaging mini-games test your reading, writing, and speaking skills, and joining a club (where you can encourage and compete with others) adds a great social element. Bonus: all those languages and games are available for free!
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Learn a new language. Join a club, chat with bots, and get reminders to practice.

lockups.title: Amazon Prime Video
lockups.subtitle: Originals, movies, TV, sports
lockups.editorialTagline: Butcher wages war on the Supes
lockups.editorialDescription: Convinced you’ve run out of things to watch? Amazon Prime Video may be able to prove otherwise. The app is brimming with brilliant films, dramas, and comedies, as well as sports and children’s TV, all available to watch on demand. We love the ultra-high-quality 4K streaming and the slick UI. Oh, and the ability to create multiple user profiles and download series to watch later. There are also hundreds of Amazon Originals to check out—great series and films produced by Amazon Studios that you won’t find anywhere else.

lockups.title: Canva AI Photo & Video Editor
lockups.subtitle: Collage Maker, Resume Builder
lockups.editorialDescription: Before Canva came along, you had to invest in some pretty serious software (and have some pretty serious skills) to create even simple graphics. But with tens of thousands of templates and nearly unlimited ways to customize them, Canva has democratized design. With this easy-to-use app, you can master logos, posters, and invitations in minutes, not months.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Quickly create posts for social media or your small business.

lockups.title: Twitch: Live Streaming
lockups.subtitle: Stream, Watch, Chat. Live.
lockups.editorialDescription: We love watching live streams of League of Legends, Roblox and everything in between. And there’s more to Twitch than games. The Travel and Outdoors category (you’ll find it in the Browse tab) has live animal cams. There’s even an entire channel dedicated to painter and teacher (and master of happy little trees) Bob Ross.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Broadcast, watch, chat and have fun.

lockups.title: NFL
lockups.subtitle: Your Home For Football
lockups.editorialTagline: Replay full games with Game Pass
lockups.editorialDescription: The ultimate app for any football fan, NFL Mobile offers an insanely robust experience from the preseason to the playoffs. A smartly designed interface puts the spotlight on colorful photos and videos, and breaking news is easy to navigate and share. The astoundingly long list of features includes drive charts, real-time scores, and live stat trackers. Plus, on-demand games, access to preseason games, and more all become available with purchase of the NFL Game Pass 2016 Subscription, so there’s always something new to watch, analyze, and read.

lockup.subtitle: Base Building Battle Strategy
lockup.editorialTagline: Can you build the best base?
lockup.editorialDescription: It's hard to understate Clash of Clans’ massive influence in establishing complex strategic multiplayer on mobile. Over time the build, train, and attack gameplay has been honed to perfection through fantastic updates. We still love logging on to find that our meticulously placed and upgraded fortifications survived another onslaught, and to experience the rush of victory after our carefully assembled attack force yet again smashed through enemy defenses.

items.inlineDescription: Build more for less in Clash of Clans.

items.heading: FROM THE EDITORS
items.title: Journal Your Way

lockups.title: Day One: Daily Journal & Diary
lockups.subtitle: Private Gratitude Journaling
lockups.editorialDescription: It’s hard to make the best even better, but the sequel to Day One lives up to expectations—and then some. The app keeps its interface streamlined but adds a wealth of new valuable features. Your journal entries contain all sorts of information—you can geolocate them, add tons of photos to each entry, and even see your day’s fitness activity. Switch over to the beautiful new photo view when you’re ready to see your world at a glance.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Record journal entries with a tap

lockups.title: Clearful - Journal & Diary
lockups.subtitle: Journaling for Personal Growth
lockups.editorialDescription: Finding a moment to pause and reflect is made a bit more effortless with Clearful. The journaling app is full of thoughtful prompts across a variety of themes that help us find moments of gratitude, check in with our mental health, and more. The power of reflection is made even more accessible with the app’s insights and reviews, which give us a chance to understand our habits and synthesize our entries into meaningful takeaways.

purchaseConfiguration.vendor: Clearful Journal, Mindfulness Diary and Mental Health Inc.

lockups.developerName: Clearful Journal, Mindfulness Diary and Mental Health Inc.

lockups.title: stoic. journal & mental health
lockups.subtitle: AI journaling, Gratitude diary
lockups.editorialDescription: Bookend your days with a moment of reflection in stoic., an elegantly designed journaling app made for anyone looking to carve out time for mindfulness. With insightful reflection prompts and breathing exercises, the app is filled with multiple ways to care for your mental health—with inspiration from stoic philosophy at its core.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Meet your daily companion for journaling, meditation and reflection.

lockups.title: 1 Second Everyday: Video Diary
lockups.subtitle: Private Journal & Time Machine
lockups.editorialDescription: This spellbinding app stitches second-long snippets from your life into a compelling personal movie. With built-in reminders, a simple editing tool, and a gorgeous design, 1 Second Everyday is everything you need to put together your own thought-provoking narrative.
lockups.shortEditorialDescription: Record one second each day for a lifetime of memories.
